description: This file defines a PHP class for compiling Smarty template {section} tags, specifically for handling {foreach} and {section} tags within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for scanning template source code for specific tag attributes, matching properties in template sources and parent templates, and compiling special variables related to Smarty's internal variables.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_ForeachSection
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling Smarty {section} and {foreach} tags, including methods for scanning template sources for relevant properties, matching properties in source code, and generating compiled PHP code for Smarty internal variables.

methods.name: scanForProperties
methods.description: Scans template source code for used tag attributes related to {section} tags, building regex patterns to match properties.

methods.name: buildPropertyPreg
methods.description: Constructs regex pattern strings to match specific tag properties in template source code.

methods.name: matchProperty
methods.description: Finds matches of the constructed regex pattern in a given source string.

methods.name: matchTemplateSource
methods.description: Matches properties in the current template source code.

methods.name: matchParentTemplateSource
methods.description: Recursively matches properties in parent template sources.

methods.name: matchBlockSource
methods.description: Placeholder for matching block source code (empty implementation).

methods.name: compileSpecialVariable
methods.description: Generates PHP code to access Smarty's internal {foreach} or {section} variables.
